sentences.show: After years of finding almost nothing, he got one last season. Then a worker found a step in the sand.
It happened on this day in 1922, in Egypt.
Howard Carter's patron, Lord Carnarvon, was about to stop paying.
He agreed to fund just one more season.
Under old huts, steps went down to a sealed doorway.
Carter covered them up, and sent a telegram.
Three weeks later, he chipped a hole in the door, with his grandmother's chisel.
He held up a candle, and looked in.
"Can you see anything?" Carnarvon asked. "Yes," said Carter. "Wonderful things."
It was the tomb of Tutankhamun, almost untouched, with over 5,000 objects.
Including a mask of solid gold.
Five months later, Lord Carnarvon was dead, of blood poisoning.
Also on this day: London opened the first deep electric tube line, and the Tehran hostage crisis began.
Every day of history hides a tomb like this. Subscribe, and be first through the door.
